headline: Fresh Pressure Mounts Along Contested Lines
war_summary: The latest returns show the front shifting rather than settling. LinnMercy has become the liveliest immediate sector, recording three strategic-base events in two hours and 36 across the day, while its casualty rates are accelerating on both sides; its ledger stands at nine Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral position. NevishLine is also stirring, with six events in the latest two hours and fourteen in 24, leaving six Warden and two Colonial bases amid sharply rising losses. Fishermans Row, quiet in the previous edition, now reports four events in two hours at Oceanwatch, with both factions represented in the day’s exchanges. The great churn in Godcrofts and PalantineBerm has paused in the newest window, though each still carries 36 daily events and contested holdings. WeatheredExpanse records one fresh event in two hours after a hard day of 29, while MarbanHollow’s 25-event tally has gone quiet recently. FarranacCoast likewise shows no new event in two hours, suggesting its earlier alarm has temporarily cooled. Elsewhere, most sectors remain firmly held and inactive.
